units.source_text: 源氏又对她说：“上皇早就看出你太孩子气，非常担心，

en.t: Genji said to her again, "The Retired Emperor saw long ago that you were far too childish, and he was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 看了这封信便可知道。

en.t: You can tell that from reading this letter.

units.source_text: 自今以后，你万事必须小心谨慎。

en.t: From now on, you must be careful and prudent in everything.

units.source_text: 我本来不想对你如此直说，

en.t: I had not meant to speak to you so bluntly,

units.source_text: 但教上皇知道我辜负了他的嘱托，我很不安心，又甚抱歉，

en.t: but if the Retired Emperor were to know that I had failed the trust he placed in me, I would be very uneasy and deeply ashamed,

units.source_text: 所以不得不向你说明。

en.t: so I have no choice but to explain this to you.

units.source_text: 你不仔细考虑，一味轻信人言，心中只管恨我疏慢冷淡，

en.t: You do not think carefully, but simply believe what others say, and in your heart you only resent me for being neglectful and cold,

units.source_text: 又见我年纪老大，姿态丑陋可厌，使我觉得遗憾而又伤心！

en.t: and because you see that I am old, ugly, and repellent, you make me feel both regretful and hurt.

units.source_text: 但愿你在上皇住世期间，顾念他向我嘱托的一片苦心，

en.t: I only hope that while the Retired Emperor is still alive, you will think of the painful concern with which he entrusted you to me,

units.source_text: 暂时忍耐，把我和年轻人同等看待，不可过分轻视。

en.t: and for a time endure, treating me as you would a younger man and not looking down on me too much.

units.source_text: 我从小就怀抱出家学道之大愿，

en.t: Since childhood I have cherished the great wish to leave the world and pursue the Buddhist path,

units.source_text: 不料几个愿力不宏的女人，反而比我先入佛门，

en.t: yet several women whose vows were not so deep have entered the Buddhist life before me,

units.source_text: 真教我惭愧无地！

en.t: which truly leaves me nowhere to hide my shame.

units.source_text: 倘能由我自己做主，我对尘世决不会迷恋不舍。

en.t: If I could decide entirely for myself, I would never cling so fondly to this dusty world.

units.source_text: 只因你父亲出家之时，将你托付与我，叫我代他保护。

en.t: It is only because, when your father took holy vows, he entrusted you to me and asked me to protect you in his place.

units.source_text: 我体谅他的苦心，且喜得他信任，便遵命接受嘱托。

en.t: I understood his painful concern, and, happy to have his trust, I obeyed and accepted the charge.

units.source_text: 我若追随了他，争先出家，也将你抛弃不管，你父亲将谓我失信背约，

en.t: If I had followed him and hastened to take vows first, abandoning you as well, your father would have said that I had broken faith and betrayed my promise,

units.source_text: 因此未能如愿以偿耳。

en.t: and that is why I have not been able to fulfill my own wish.

units.source_text: 我所关怀的子女，现在都已成长，不复是我出家的羁绊了。

en.t: The children I was concerned for have all grown up now, and they are no longer an obstacle to my taking vows.

units.source_text: 明石女御将来如何虽不可知，但子女日渐众多，

en.t: Although I cannot know what the future holds for the Akashi Consort, her children are steadily increasing in number,

units.source_text: 只要我在世时平安无事，以后不须担心了。

en.t: and as long as all remains peaceful while I am alive, there will be no need to worry afterward.

units.source_text: 此外诸夫人，都顺从我，都已到了不惜与我一同出家的年龄。

en.t: As for the other ladies, they all obey me and have reached an age when they would not regret taking vows together with me.

units.source_text: 我的顾虑便越来越减轻。

en.t: Thus my anxieties are becoming lighter and lighter.

units.source_text: 你父亲世寿所余无多，而且病势日见沉重，心情常是郁结。

en.t: Your father has little time left in this world, his illness grows heavier by the day, and his heart is often burdened with gloom.

units.source_text: 今后你切不可再度流传意外的恶名，使他听了伤心！

en.t: From now on, you must never again let some unexpected disgraceful rumor spread and wound him when he hears it.

units.source_text: 他在现世已很安稳，不会有什么问题了。

en.t: In this present life he is already at peace, and there should be no further trouble.

units.source_text: 只是妨碍他往生极乐，其罪实甚可怕！”

en.t: But if you hinder his rebirth in paradise, the sin would be truly terrible."

units.source_text: 话中虽然不曾明言柏木之事，然而针针见血，

en.t: Although his words never openly mentioned Kashiwagi, every point struck home,

units.source_text: 使得三公主眼泪淌个不住，伤心之极，竟至昏迷不醒。

en.t: so that the Third Princess could not stop her tears, and in the extremity of grief she finally fainted and did not wake.

units.source_text: 源氏也哭起来，说道：“从前我听老人教训，觉得很不耐烦，

en.t: Genji too began to weep and said, "In the past, when I heard old people lecturing me, I found it terribly tiresome,

units.source_text: 想不到现在自己也变了老人。

en.t: but I never imagined that I myself would now become an old man.

units.source_text: 你听了我这番话，大概也觉得这个讨厌的老翁絮聒不休，很不耐烦吧？”

en.t: Hearing all this from me, you probably think this hateful old man is rambling on and on, and you must be very impatient with me."

units.source_text: 他自己也觉得可耻。

en.t: He himself felt ashamed.

units.source_text: 便把砚台取过来，亲自磨墨，又取出信笺，教三公主写回信。

en.t: Then he drew the inkstone toward him, ground the ink himself, took out writing paper, and told the Third Princess to write a reply.

units.source_text: 但三公主两手发抖，一时写不出来。

en.t: But the Third Princess's hands were trembling, and for a while she could not write.

units.source_text: 源氏推想：她对柏木那封详细的情书写回信时，

en.t: Genji imagined that when she had written a reply to Kashiwagi's detailed love letter,

units.source_text: 恐怕是洋洋洒洒，畅所欲言的吧。

en.t: she had probably written at length and freely said everything she wanted to say.

units.source_text: 便觉此人十分可恶，对她的怜爱之心全都消失了。

en.t: At that thought he found her utterly hateful, and all his tender affection for her vanished.

units.source_text: 然而还是教她如何措词。

en.t: Even so, he still taught her how to phrase the letter.

units.source_text: 后来又对她说：“你要上朱雀院贺寿，

en.t: Later he said to her again, "If you are to go to Suzaku-in to offer birthday congratulations,

units.source_text: 本月已经来不及了。

en.t: there is no longer time to do it this month.

units.source_text: 况且你姐姐二公主的贺仪非常体面，

en.t: Besides, your elder sister, the Second Princess, made a very impressive formal visit of congratulations,

units.source_text: 你这怀孕之身，和她并肩拜寿，恐怕相形见绌吧。

en.t: and if you, pregnant as you are, were to stand beside her and offer your respects, you would probably seem inferior by comparison.

units.source_text: 十一月是父皇桐壶帝的忌月。

en.t: The eleventh month is the memorial month for my father, Emperor Kiritsubo.

units.source_text: 年底事情又很烦忙，况且那时你的身子更加难看，

en.t: At year's end matters will be very busy, and by then your body will look even more unsightly,

units.source_text: 叫汝父看了不快。

en.t: which would displease your father if he saw you.

units.source_text: 然而总不能一直延搁下去。

en.t: Still, we cannot keep delaying it forever.

units.source_text: 你不可只管忧愁苦闷，快把精神振作起来。

en.t: You must not do nothing but grieve and brood; quickly rouse your spirits.

units.source_text: 形容如此消瘦，应该好好调养。”

en.t: You look so thin and wasted that you ought to take proper care of yourself."

units.source_text: 可知他毕竟是怜爱她的。

en.t: From this it can be seen that, after all, he did love and pity her.
